notes.title: PFS Update 12
notes.notes: [p][b]Update 12[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]If you find any bugs, think a feature is bad or something like that lemme know.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]- Improved most of the UI [/p][p]  - Health Bar[/p][p]  - Ammo counter[/p][p]  - Menus (like main menu and options menus) [/p][p]- You can make an invite only server[/p][p]- You can now invite friends through steam and join people through steam[/p][p]- Tweaked Vote Banning slightly (grace period for newly joined players)[/p][p]- You can spin the gus in the menu by drag clicking[/p][p]- Added a new game rule called 'Pistol Snipe only' which means servers with this game rule will only allow players to use the pistol and sniper. There could be a few bugs with this feature so lemme know if you find them. [/p][p]- Cannonballs might have been broken? dunno for how long it was but they work now.[/p][p]- there are goblins somewhere[/p][p][/p][p][b](cheeky ramble)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hello pirate gamers there's been a lack of consistent updates for pfs which is due to being busy with real life stuff and that. So i apologise for the few of you who would like to see more cool stuff or stuff in general in the game. I have fun updating it and i got some ideas i wanna do like a boat map and overhauling the visuals with new models, textures and animations among other things. But i wouldn't expect that anytime soon, it really just depends on if i have the energy and time for it. Just wanted to share the reason for the lack of updates and say that the void between them will probably not change lol considering the last 'large' update was 7 months ago. And thats about it, cya! [/p]

notes.title: PFS Update 11.3
notes.notes:
Small update

- Fixed kills not updating for newly joined players
- Additions to the keybind settings (like movement binds)
- Steam cloud saves
- UI Debug Button ('F8' key to reset the UI since the UI in the game can break a lot)
- Updated some of the store and library images so that it looks less crunchy

notes.title: PFS Update 11.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed the timer stopping in KoTC after entering a cannon
- Fixed when you fired your gun before picking up the cannon it would reload the cannon when you pick it up
- Reverted blunderbomb swap delay 
- Moved the KoTC cannon spawn location up slightly so you can't get it from underneath
- Added a couple more posters

notes.title: PFS Update 11
notes.notes:
- Created a new gamemode called 'King of The Cannon' with a new weapon called the hand cannon. hopefully this plays well but any problems or suggestions let me know!
- Christmasified the maps
- Got rid of the ability to change map styles temporarily so i can force everyone to play the christmas maps
- Fixed when you spam eat the bannana it only played the animation once
- Fixed the 90 degree angle pose gus can do when you kill him sometimes (i think)
- Fixed not being able to shoot after eating all of your bananas
- I'm trying something out so i made a kofi page and there you can request a wanted poster to put in pfs, no obligation to request one though just figured it could be fun https://ko-fi.com/meksdev

Just by the way cheers to those of you who still play this jankfest of a game a year later i obviously still enjoy updating it and will continue to do so every now and again with what i think could be fun to add or make the game more interesting. any suggestions you put in the pfs discord ill also consider. this update is kinda small and i did test it a few times and it seemed to work but obviously i could have missed something so if you encounter or spot any bugs let me know in the pfs discord. Merry Pirate Fighting Simulatormas!

notes.title: PFS Version 10.1
notes.notes:
Just a small update
- Unhalloweened the tavern
- made an option to choose the style of map either normal or halloween
- goblins are gone but not forever.

notes.title: PFS Update 10
notes.notes:
Fixes and Features:
- Halloweenified the maps 
- Added a vote kick system for non private lobbies 
- Made a message on the cannons to inform people they can load them 
- Didn't realise the name plates above players head were not there so ive fixed it for the most part but it 
can still be buggy sometimes 
- Menu Gus's pants change colour with whatever you selected 
- Added some ambience to the maps
- There are two goblins somewhere dunno where though...

(Didn't have a huge amount of time to test and fix things so might be a couple bugs, if you find any let me know)

notes.title: Update 9.1
notes.notes:
Small bug fixes

- Fixed Blunderbomb not despawning after doing its job leaving behind laggy patches
- Fixed being able to load into a cannon after you die
- Pants customisation saves reliably now

notes.title: PFS Update 9
notes.notes:
Fixes and Features:
- Cannons are now useable
- Added more stuff to TDMer Island (Will add more at some point)
- Custom pants colouring
- Made aiming down sight feel more consistant
- Made bullet impact effects
- Increased the knockback for the blunderbomb
- Made the hipfire inaccuracy more consistant
- Fixed when you first killed someone and it added 2 to the score
- Made an option to disable the fov change when aiming down sight

I did a good amount of testing and it seemed all good to me but there could probably also be a few bugs that i don't know about especially with the cannons so if you encounter any make sure to post it either under here or on the discord

notes.title: PFS Update 8.2
notes.notes: Another wicked small update hopefully this time i made the end of round / beginning of round work and not crash after the countdown i think it is actually fixed this time but if there's any crazy bugs or such drop them in the discord or in the comments of this post.

notes.title: Rolled Back To Update 8.0 For Now
notes.notes: So some rather crazy and quite wacky things have occured when i switched the engine and it seems to like to crash every 5 seconds so im gonna go back to update 8.0 for now i don't know for sure if that crashing at when loading into the next round is still a thing but ill see if i can't find a way to make that work properly.

notes.title: PFS Update 8.1
notes.notes:
Wicked small update

- Moved from UE 5.0.3 to UE 5.1.1 (might help with that crashing when moving to next level it seems to work for me so hopefully that's fixed, also im pretty sure everything is the same but if theres any crazy bugs report them in the discord or under the post)
- Made TDMer Island a bit deeper between the fort and the cannon

notes.title: PFS Update 8.0
notes.notes:
Fixes and Features:
- When the game ends you don't have to choose another server you can keep playing continuously unless the server owner leaves.
- Fixed the TDM gamemode from switching you randomly when you spawn
- The Kill Confirmed widget now stacks when you get multiple kills
- Disabled a few Unreal Engine 5 features to make the game run smoother
- Made it so a message pops up telling the user that the version is mismatched

What ill do:
- Make some more gamemodes like Capture The Flag
- Make Facing Forts a finished map

notes.title: PFS Update 7.1
notes.notes: - When you press tab to check the scoreboard the text chat box would get selected, this should be fixed now

notes.title: PFS Update 7
notes.notes:
- Added a version number to servers in case the host and you have different versions
- Added damage numbers where ever you hit your enemy (this can be turned off in the settings)
- Pressing the quick switch bind for the first time after dying won't swtich right away so thats been fixed
- Moved the kicking system from the leaderboard to the game menu (will make a vote kick system in the future)
- A Text Chat has been added (This can also be turned off in the settings)

notes.title: PFS Update 6.2
notes.notes: - Made The health more reliable (if it acts wicked sus just say under this post and ill revert it for now)

notes.title: PFS Update 6
notes.notes:
- Added Menu Music from 'CrowGoblin' on the official PFS Discord
- Added a slider for Music in the audio options menu
- Made the weapon loadout more reliable (i think anyway if there's still issues put it under this post or in the pfs discord)
- For now i made the players and ping in the server browser hidden because it doesn't add anything
- Also disabled Quick Find as that also seems to not work sometimes
- Added another option for switching guns (Default 'Q' you can change in the keybinds menu)

notes.title: PFS Update 5
notes.notes:
- Made the TDM gamemode less likley to just not put you on a team
- Fixed the bug in the server browser that read TDMer Island as Facing Forts sometimes
- Made an option to invert either X or Y for the mouse

notes.title: PFS Update 4
notes.notes: Made a button in the create server menu that shows unsupported maps (Facing Forts) so you can peep it and play it but i won't be doing anything with it for a while or at all just noticed some facing forts servers and thought i'd at least make the map playable

notes.title: PFS Update 3.5
notes.notes:
- The little indicator that tells you if your weapon in stowed should only come up when its meant to now.

Also could anyone tell me if the seeing names through walls when you die fix worked from update 3?

notes.title: PFS Update 3
notes.notes:
- Potentially fixed the nameplate being seen through walls after you die
- Added a widget that tells you if you stowed you're weapon or not because i think some people might get confused why their gun disappeared. You can turn this off in the options menu if it gets annoying though.

notes.title: New PFS Update 2
notes.notes:
- Added another crate to TDMer Island near the cannon on the other side of the map to the fort
- Aiming down sight as soon as you died sometimes makes the sniper ads widget stay on screen i believe this is fixed hopefully

Also just so people know that in the server browser i don't think the player count and ping work as they should so don't believe them.

notes.title: New PFS Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed Blunderbomb not showing up after sprinting.
- Stopped the character from sliding when dead (i think)
- Added a new spawn point to The Spire (on the big rock with the platform

If there are any other issues i think you can comment under the post or you can just use the discussions page. can't fix issues with skill though unfortunately.
